FN-HCGK633-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 275
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/03/2024
Senate Bill 275 as introduced would allow an agriculture authority to develop commercial
facilities and use any additional revenues gained from the facility to support the authority's
mission. This bill would not directly affect state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-HCGK633-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 275
Committee: Economic Development and Tourism Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/15/2024
Senate Bill 275 as passed the Senate would allow an agriculture authority to raise revenue for
the authority, develop commercial facilities, acquire lands or other assets for the facility, and use
any additional revenues gained from the facility to support the authority's mission.
